# 金光明經疏

**ID:** T1787
**Volume:** T39
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經疏部
**Byline:** 隋 吉藏撰
**Dynasty:** 隋
**Date:** 549–623
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1787

## Contributors
- 吉藏 (A000329)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T1787 is [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F)'s single-fascicle commentary on *[Jīnguāngmíng jīng 金光明經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301)* (T663) — a relatively short text by the standards of the Sānlùn master's prolific commentarial corpus, but historically important as the only major non-Tiāntái Suí commentary on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* and as evidence of how Madhyamaka 三論 doctrinal categories were applied to a sūtra normally read through Tiāntái lenses.

**Abstract**

The work bears the clean attribution 沙門吉藏撰 in the Taishō witness. Date bracket follows [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F)'s mature productive period at Jiāxiángsì 嘉祥寺 in Kuàijī and subsequently at the Suí imperial chapels (590–623); the commentary is generally placed in the late Suí or very early Táng on the basis of doctrinal vocabulary. The opening lays out the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* programme in characteristically Sānlùn terms: the Buddha's *fǎshēn* 法身 (Dharma-body) is "obscure and quiet, with no long or short lifespan" (法身幽寂壽無長短); compassion responds to the conditions of beings (至人絕慮有感必通); skilful means (大權方便) takes shape in accordance with the capacities of the audience. This framing positions T1787 as a Madhyamaka rebuttal of any reified reading of the Buddha's *Shòuliàng* (lifespan) doctrine — exactly the doctrinal point on which the Tiāntái commentaries (T1783, T1785) build their distinctive position.

The text is presumably an abridgement of a longer earlier work; cross-references in [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F)'s other commentaries indicate that he had also composed a more extensive *Sānlùn xuányì* on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* that is now lost. T1787 is therefore best treated as a digest, but a doctrinally coherent one. It was little used in subsequent Chinese commentarial transmission, but is a key witness to early Suí *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* exegesis outside the Tiāntái lineage.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301) (金光明經 / T663).
